title: History of Toyota | Founded in 1937
content: Toyota Motor Corporation was founded 28th August 1937 by Kilchiro Toyoda, in Japan. In July 2012 Toyota produced its 200 millionth vehicle.

title: History of Toyota | Trajectory of Toyota | Company | Toyota Motor Corporation Official Global Website
content: # History of Toyota. Ever since its founding, Toyota has pursued business activities centered on the production and sale of automobiles, with the aim of contributing to a more prosperous society. Here, we introduce Toyota's history from its founding to the present day. ## The Beginnings. Taking on the Automotive Business -Setting Course to Enter Automotive Business-. From 1937 -Establishment of Toyota Motor Co., Ltd.-. 1940s -Automobile Prototypes, Research and Development of Basic Technology-. 1950s -Business Management Crisis (Labor dispute); Establishment of Toyota Motor Sales Co., Ltd.-. ## Inheritance and Evolution. 1960s -Mass Production Systems Established; Development of Mass-market Vehicle-. 1970s -Satisfying Public Needs (Emissions standards, Oil crisis)-. 1980s -Sales and Manufacturing Operations Merged to Form Toyota Motor Corporation; Full-scale Overseas Production Launched-. 1990s -Response to Environmental and Safety Issues-. 2000s -Rapid Expansion of Globalization-. From 2010s75 Years of Toyota.

title: History of Toyota | TOYOTA Motor Manufacturing UK
content: toyota-world-banner-range.jpg. # History of Toyota. Toyota's origins lie in the Japanese weaving industry when Sakichi Toyoda invented the world's first automatic loom and, subsequently, set up the Toyoda Spinning and Weaving Company in 1918. This in turn led to the launch of the Company's first ever passenger car in 1936, the Model AA, and in 1937, the Toyota Motor Company was born. Production of Toyota vehicles outside Japan began in 1959 in Brazil and now, besides its own plants, manufacturing subsidiaries and affiliates in Japan, Toyota manufactures Toyota and Lexus brand vehicles and components throughout the world. Look back at the history of Toyota, starting with the birth of founder Sakichi Toyoda. Find out more about the history of Toyota on the Toyota Motor Corporation website. Come directly to the source at our Burnaston state of the art manufacturing facility and learn more about Toyota's approach to manufacturing. At every stage of a vehicle's life, Toyota strives to protect the environment through reducing energy use and minimising waste.

content: ## JayFm Live's Post. ### **JayFm Live**. The company was founded by Kiichiro Toyoda in 1937, as a spinoff from his father's company Toyota Industries to create automobiles. In 2017, Toyota's corporate structure consisted of 364,445 employees worldwide and, as of October 2017, was the fifth-largest company in the world by revenue. As of 2017, Toyota is the world's second-largest automotive manufacturer. As of July 2014, Toyota was the largest listed company in Japan by market capitalization worth more than twice as much as #2-ranked SoftBank and by revenue.
